test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The average production of motorcycles of companies A, B and C is what percentage less than the demand of motorcycles of D?
solution:
Production of motorcycles of companies A, B and C = 75 + 90 + 135

⇒ 300

Average production of motorcycles A, B and C = 300/3

⇒ 100

Demand of motorcycles of D = 125

Required percentage = [(125 - 100)/125] × 100

⇒ (25/125) × 100

⇒ 20%

**∴ The average production of motorcycles of companies A, B and C is 20% less than the demand of motorcycles of D.**
